service_method: Personal delivery of summons and complaint to Corporation Service Company, Harbor Street Bakery LLC's Delaware registered agent, through authorized intake specialist Dana Whitlock
removal_reason: The complaint alleges a Washington corporate plaintiff. The client identifies Harbor Street's only current LLC members as Caleb Sorensen (35%, lives in Seattle) and Noor Haddad (65%, lives in Portland). Assuming they were the only members when suit began and those homes are their domiciles, Harbor Street is a Washington and Oregon citizen, defeating complete diversity; as a served Washington defendant it also triggers the forum-defendant bar. The client did not confirm membership on the September 8 filing date, and residence alone does not conclusively establish domicile. Removal jurisdiction cannot be established on this record. The $129,156.40 principal demand exceeds $75,000.
